title: Chapter 539
paragraphs: Chapter 539
Episode 145. Premonition (8)
The Imperial Army suffered approximately 20,000 casualties, and the Gwamhwang Castle sustained about 2,000 casualties.

The casualties of the Imperial Army were not ordinary soldiers, but knights and mages. Several core figures, including Imperial Swordmaster Jon Shina Ferrell, had died, and over 90% of their dragons and war equipment were either captured or destroyed.

The casualties at the Gwamhwang Castle were mostly the Hairan knights and ordinary knights who had gathered for Hairan. Individuals like Shuras were injured, but the core figures of the Vamel Alliance and Hairan were hardly affected. It was difficult to find fatal wounds among commanders and above.
The total death rates were approximately 30% and 10%, respectively, and the first battle was an overwhelming victory for Gwamhwang Castle.
However, both sides had suffered devastating damage.
The emperor lost too many talents due to an unjust purge. The prestige of the empire would not be the same as before, and the imperial power was the same.
It would not be strange if a new rebellion began centered around Henseurk and Lillestagar.
Or it could have gathered around Hairan.
The imperial justification and public sentiment pointed to Hairan. Unlike the emperor who forgot his honor, Hairan stood against his tyranny and kept his promise.
It was a promise not to kill those who were fleeing. Jin and Dante, and all their people, practiced this.
Even those who attacked Hairan until yesterday wanted to stand by Hairan if they could.

However, Henseurk and Lillestagar also suffered significant damage, and the fact that Zifur was behind the emperor was known to the world, so such things did not happen. Hairan had no reason to accept those who had pointed their swords at him until the last minute.
Above all.

The war was not over yet. The fact that Zifur's new fleet was heading for Gwamhwang Castle was now known to everyone, not just the battlefield. The sight of the fleet flying was being spotted everywhere.
Unlike Runcandel, the Vamel Alliance and Hairan did not know about the change of the first Martap.
However, just looking at the confirmed fleet size, it was not difficult to infer that at least Octavia Zifur, or perhaps Kelliark, could come.
As Rosa said, it was best to abandon Gwamhwang Castle and retreat. However, as she expected, Jin did not leave.
He couldn't.
"Dante..."
Dante Hairan.
Currently, he was trapped in a seal, presumably due to the influence of the White Stone, and was in a state where any communication was impossible.
It was a black seal like a spiritual energy.
The black power forming the seal was the spirit of chaos that Jin had experienced several times before. Its purity was higher than any chaos Jin had ever experienced.
Jin was looking at his friend in the seal that spread out in a semicircular shape in the middle of the battlefield.
'The spirit of chaos from Amela is not even comparable, it's deeper than the chaos shown by Yona.'
It felt like it could be called a spirit rather than a chaos.
Jin had always easily cut through this type of seal with the power of spiritual energy and blue fire, but this time nothing worked.
The healing priests of the Holy Kingdom stood next to Jin, showing a sorry expression.
"I apologize, Lord Jin. After the first round of healing, we left our place for a while to take care of other casualties…"

"Don't say that. Without the priests, he might have died. And this seal has nothing to do with you. The ones who should be sorry and grateful to the Holy Kingdom are the Vamel Alliance and Gwamhwang Castle."
"…From the beginning of the healing, he showed an unusually tremendous recovery."
After rescuing Dante from Jon Shina Ferrell, Jin told him to rest until he could fight again.
In fact, Jin didn't think Dante could participate in this war again.
Dante's frail body, like a form of punishment, was already past its limit several times.
It seemed that it would take at least three days to walk properly, and at least three months to recover enough to fight.
However, Dante recovered enough for the healers to leave their places in just a few hours after the healing began.
It was the power of the white stone.
Then Dante, as if possessed, found the deepest place in the fortress. Following the voice of the white stone, he found the place where his grandfather had fallen unconscious.
And as soon as he removed the white stone that his grandfather was holding and returned to the battlefield, he was sealed.
"…Please continue to assist the wounded, priests. The Vamel Alliance and Gwamhwang Castle will not forget the grace of the Holy Kingdom."
"If it wasn't for you, we wouldn't have been able to fulfill our mission as priests after the incident in the Holy Kingdom. We will pray earnestly to Ayula that you will not be harmed."
As the priests stepped back, Murakan and Quicantel entered the battlefield.
"How are the knights?"

"What do you mean, how are they? The atmosphere is that they will never leave Dante behind. Damn it, that white stone is tripping us up till the end. This kind of seal is the first for me and Quicantel."
Dante, hidden by the chaos seal, was blurry, but the white stone was spreading a gloomy light in the middle. It looked like Dante's heart.
"There are hardly any humans who waver knowing that the white stone actually exists."
"It's no use even if you say that you can't use the same power again. It's not that I don't understand, but staying still like this is just a suicide..."
After Jin manifested the will of Solderet and Clam, the mirror had lost its power.
Every time Jin infused spiritual energy, the mirror's functions were slowly returning, but it was too slow. He couldn't use its power in the war again.
Jin also understood the hearts of the knights.
He himself was not confident to leave Dante as it is.
Boooong-!
The sound of Mort's cry came from behind.
Talaris had only moved Jin and his party using Mort and had not officially participated in the battle of Gwamhwang Castle.
From the beginning, she came here not as Jin's reinforcements, but as the Lord of the Secret Palace to fulfill her mission, so she did not reveal herself to anyone except Jin and his comrades.
Jin felt anxious as soon as she appeared.
Because if she decided to fulfill her mission as the Lord of the Secret Palace, claiming that Dante was trying to use the white stone, there would be no answer.
Dante now looked like he was sealed while trying to use the white stone to anyone who saw him.
"Lady Talaris, Dante is…"
"I know what you're worried about, son-in-law."
Talaris knew what kind of seal the white stone created. It was recorded in the Secret Palace.
"This is a barrier originating from the rejection of chaos. Your friend, Ron's grandson, is currently fighting chaos within himself. So, I don't have a reason to fulfill my mission yet."
He felt relieved, but the expression 'not yet' bothered him.
'A barrier born out of rejecting chaos... if Dante loses the fight against chaos and uses its power, Lady Talaris will not help Gwamhwang Castle.'
The Secret Palace assumes the white stone is a possession of Heluram.
And Heluram was a disaster itself. In any era, in any space, the power of the witch brought great disaster to humanity the moment it manifested. Always, without a single exception.
"Son-in-law."
"Yes, Lady Talaris."
"In my opinion, this war may not only be a war between the Empire and Gwamhwang Castle, but also between Zipple and Runcandel."
A problem of all humanity.
Talaris was accepting the white stone as such.
Whiii...!
Ice formed in Talaris' hand. At the same time, she concentrated a tremendous energy into the blade of ice and struck at the seal.
However, even with her strike, not even a small crack appeared in the white stone's seal.
Rather, it was a sight of Talaris retreating as if she had been bounced back, catching her breath.
"……It's a seal that withstands even the absolute power of ice. Do you know what this means?"
It means that there is chaos inside that I can't even handle.
Talaris continued.
"Hey, Lord of the Secret Palace. Is it that serious?"
"It's not an exaggeration, Black Dragon Brother. I can't even guess which between this and another threat that our Secret Palace is suppressing will be more problematic for the world…….”
Eloana Zipple.
Most of the power Talaris and the Ice Sword have is always used to maintain Eloana Zipple's seal.
She was contemplating whether to damage Eloana's seal to stop the white stone.
"I guessed it was significant considering Zipple's anxious behavior, but I didn't expect it to be this severe."
"Can Dante... return?"
"If I say he can't return, will you leave him behind?"
Talaris had seen a similar case in the Secret Palace records. In those records, humans exposed to chaos became monsters.
Jin also knew the existence of Smarion Proci, a monster eroded by chaos.
Dante may have already crossed a river from which he can't return.
"That's not it."

"Dante has to withstand the acquired chaos like your father or cousin. In some ways... It might be fortunate that Zipple's main force is coming and Runcandel is waiting nearby. If the chaos of the white stone awakens, they will have to fight against it whether they like it or not. Without them and us, nobody can stop it."
Major forces are fighting for the hegemony of the world.
So, as was the case during the kingdom's defense war, it was only natural to first resolve an event that could destroy the world as a whole.
"You and your comrades will be the same. Ideally, chaos should not awaken until the end. Then, the war between major forces or negotiations will conclude the situation."
At that moment.
The white stone inside the seal began to emit a more gloomy light. The shape of the light looked exactly like a human mouth mocking someone.
"...Honestly, I don't feel the possibility is high. The situation is not good in many ways."
If the war or negotiations continue without the chaos awakening, Hairan will perish in some way.
Conversely, it was the same if chaos awoke. Even if all the people on the battlefield fought against chaos, Hairan could not avoid destruction.
In that case, the one who awakened chaos would be Dante.
"Hoo, I'll go check on Ron for now. If that man wakes up, there will be some hope for Gwamhwang Castle."
Talaris opened the dimensional gate and went to the inner castle to see Ron, and Jin looked at Dante beyond the seal.
So, the two could only desperately hope for their friends to wake up.
